The station rings on the upper arm are gone, and the forearm swell is lower and blends in. The paw is thicker, with a front-view edge-on width of .038 to .040 against a .035 wrist. verdict.reason: m07 forearm-profile and m02 left: the horizontal station rings on the upper arm and above the elbow are gone, leaving a smooth round shaft. m07 forepaw-front: the claws are now curved hooks at the paw tip instead of straight needle spikes, and the paw is slightly wider than the wrist (m02 front).
